name: Preference-based Grouping
description: Everyone privately picks up to 3 peers; AhaSlides auto-forms balanced groups that maximise satisfied picks, prioritising mutual choices. Individual picks stay private — only the final groups are shown.
tagline: Everyone chooses. AhaSlides does the grouping.
notes: V1 descriptor. Real host-side registration (wiring these URLs + flags into the presenter/audience apps and the marketplace listing) is a follow-up — see the PR body.
